question: Where should the ritual altar be prepared when a maṇḍala has already been established?
premises: An altar ground must be made.
Possible locations include the front of a building or elsewhere.
inference: The altar should be prepared in the maṇḍala area, either at the front of a building or in another suitable place.
plain_english: Having prepared a maṇḍala, one should make the altar ground at the front of a building or elsewhere.
